answer.text:
The handbook doesn't say.

However, internal conversations indicate that it is not recommended to have more than one Accelevents event open in different tabs in the same browser. Team members have reported that this can cause issues with settings getting mixed up between events, likely due to browser cache or session conflicts. If you need to compare events, it is suggested to use different browsers or incognito windows for each event instead [ticket:4017#1][slack:deal-desk:1780059600.000000#1][slack:deal-desk:1780059600.000000#3].

nodes.text: The handbook does not explicitly state that it is okay to have multiple events open in different tabs in Accelevents. However, the previous prohibition and warning about cache contamination from having multiple events open in the same browser was removed in MR !21567 (Edits from Accelevents Vendor)
